title: Pier 68
specs: Location at Long Key provides quick access to Atlantic oceanside and bayside fishing
Nearby snorkeling spots include Tennessee Reef and Coffins Patch
Renter must be at least 30 years old to rent powerboats
Valid government photo ID and major credit card required
Operators must comply with Florida boating laws; Boater Safety Education I.D. Card may be required
Guests should have a Florida fishing license for fishing
Pontoon boats carry up to 12 people

blurb: Guests rent boats including power/fishing boats, deck boats, pontoons, and kayaks to explore bayside and oceanside waters near Long Key. Fishing and snorkeling gear are available for rent or purchase. The location provides easy access to fishing and snorkeling spots such as Tennessee Reef and Coffins Patch.
